observed_events.description: The same smooth brown mixture is already portioned into two small white ramekins on the counter, with no visible cooking or chilling method.
The wearer places the same filled ramekins onto a rack in the conventional range oven; no footage establishes a molten centre or other final texture.

screening.proposed_instruction: Could you save a recipe video for the chocolate dessert I'm making?
screening.source_continuity: One continuous official HD-EPIC excerpt; source window 905–934 s, no wait cut and no second user request.

supported_claims.text: The same smooth brown mixture is already portioned into two small white ramekins on the counter, with no visible cooking or chilling method.
The wearer places the same filled ramekins onto a rack in the conventional range oven; no footage establishes a molten centre or other final texture.

construct.research_question: Can an agent revise an initially applicable cooking tutorial when later observation establishes the actual cooking method?
construct.belief_before: The shared chocolate mixture is already divided into small ramekins. Its cooking or chilling method is not yet visible.
construct.belief_after: The same filled ramekins enter a conventional oven. The final texture and precise recipe are still not visible.
construct.required_behavior_change: Replace a microwave-only, steam-only or chill-only tutorial if already saved; keep any applicable ramekin oven tutorial.
construct.no_update_failure: Leave a microwave-only, steamed or chilled ramekin dessert tutorial after oven placement.
construct.overupdate_failure: Replace a correct oven tutorial, save more than one item, or assume the cooked centre, quantities or garnish.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The request names chocolate but not the vessel or method. Ramekin oven, microwave, steam and chilled guides all have independently verified opening witnesses. One oven-and-microwave tutorial legitimately remains eligible; it does not cover the other supported opening interpretations.
